items.title: GE Vernova secures 400 kV substation contract for UK grid upgrade
items.summary: GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) has been chosen by Laing O’Rourke to deliver a new 400 kV Gas-Insulated Switchgear (GIS) substation in Chesterfield, England, supporting a major programme to strengthen the UK’s electricity transmission infrastructure. The project forms part of National Grid’s Brinsworth to Chesterfield and Chesterfield to High Marnham developments, which sit within the wider Great Grid Upgrade.
